attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"The last remaining Marrow League settlement is now under siege","reason":"Briefing says the League has 3 settlements, not one."},{"span":"with no reinforcements in sight","reason":"Detail about reinforcements is not in the briefing."},{"span":"though they have not offered any public statement on their intentions","reason":"Briefing says nothing about Starling Tribe statements."},{"span":"the Marrow League’s last stronghold","reason":"Contradicts the 3 settlements given in the briefing."},{"span":"Last Lantern remains silent, as it has for some time","reason":"Unsupported claim about Last Lantern's behaviour."}],"voice":1,"clarity":3,"tone":2,"overall":1,"comment":"It opens with a copied briefing heading, which breaks character.
